df640d99220c4ecfaae3bb4203f186aa41ad550f.sourceText: 本节点近似配对的是 `Odometry` 和 `Path`，不是带时间戳的速度；输入速度没有时间戳，只缓存最近值。收到局部路径会刷新“控制器活跃”时间；最近0.5秒内有路径时，非零速度等待配对回调处理，否则直接按当前保存的 yaw 转换。近似配对不能证明路径、位姿、速度对应同一时刻。
df640d99220c4ecfaae3bb4203f186aa41ad550f.translatedText: This node approximately pairs `Odometry` and `Path`; it is not a timestamped velocity\. The input velocity has no timestamp, and only the most recent value is cached\. Receiving a local path refreshes the "controller active" time\. When there is a path within the last 0\.5 seconds, a nonzero velocity waits for the pairing callback to process it; otherwise, it is directly converted using the currently saved yaw\. Approximate pairing cannot prove that the path, pose, and velocity correspond to the same instant in time\.
